why: Includes are expanded depth-first, so a cycle never terminates — the compiler would keep reopening the same header. Note this is a *module* cycle, not a runtime one: breaking it changes which declarations are visible, not the execution order.
fix: move the shared declarations into a third header that both sides include
or drop one of the two includes if it is only needed for a type that can be forward-declared
